units.source_text: “我一直无法摆脱对亡友的这份愧疚，

en.t: I could never free myself from this guilt toward my dead friend,

units.source_text: 其实我从一开始就害怕会是这样的，

en.t: in fact, I had feared from the very beginning that it would turn out this way,

units.source_text: 就连这些年来所期望的结婚，也不能不说是在心神不宁中举行的。

en.t: and even the marriage I had long hoped for cannot really be said to have taken place without uneasiness.

units.source_text: 然而，人是无法预见自己的未来的，

en.t: Yet no person can foresee his own future,

units.source_text: 我也以为结婚说不定会成为使自己心情一转，步入新生涯的开端。

en.t: and I also thought that marriage might perhaps become the start of a new life, changing my state of mind.

units.source_text: 但是，作为丈夫，同妻子朝夕相处后，

en.t: But once I began living with my wife day and night as her husband,

units.source_text: 我那虚幻的希望，便在严酷的现实面前脆弱地破灭了。

en.t: that fragile hope of mine was easily shattered before the harshness of reality.

units.source_text: 我和妻子在一起时，会突然感受到K的威胁，

en.t: When I was with my wife, I would suddenly feel threatened by K,

units.source_text: 仿佛妻子站在我和K的中间，将我们连接在一起，

en.t: as though my wife stood between K and me and bound us together,

units.source_text: 无时无刻都不能分离。

en.t: so that we could never be separated for even a moment.

units.source_text: 我对妻子没有任何不满，

en.t: I had no dissatisfaction with my wife at all,

units.source_text: 只是因为这种感觉，而想避开她。

en.t: but because of this feeling alone, I wanted to avoid her.

units.source_text: 妻子很快便察觉到了，

en.t: My wife noticed it very quickly,

units.source_text: 虽然察觉了，却不知是什么缘故。

en.t: but although she noticed, she did not know the reason.

units.source_text: 于是，我常常受到她的诘问：‘你为什么老是心事重重的？

en.t: And so she would often question me: Why are you always so preoccupied?

units.source_text: 有什么不满意的吗？’

en.t: Is there something you are unhappy about?

units.source_text: 若能够付之笑谈，敷衍过去，倒还无事，

en.t: If I could laugh it off and gloss it over, there was no trouble,

units.source_text: 但有时妻子会不依不饶，

en.t: but at times my wife would not let the matter go,

units.source_text: 以至于说出‘你不会是厌弃我了吧？’

en.t: until she would say things like, Surely you have come to dislike me?

units.source_text: ‘你一定有什么事情瞒着我’等等怨言，

en.t: or You must be hiding something from me, and other reproaches,

units.source_text: 每每都使我痛苦万分。

en.t: and each time they caused me unbearable pain.
